back: Extra benefits you receive from a job in addition to your salary, such as a company car or health insurance.
An invisible barrier that prevents certain groups (often women or minorities) from being promoted to the highest levels of a company.
An informal expression meaning to have a huge amount of work to do.
A person who is very ambitious and is likely to be successful in their career.
To be moved to a lower position or rank in a company, often as a punishment (the opposite of promoted).
To be chosen from a large group of applicants for a final interview or the next stage of selection.
A reduction in the amount of money you earn from your job.
A team or system that lacks a rigid structure; its opposite is 'tightly knit'.
A career path that offers little change or opportunity for growth.
Lacking the drive or interest to perform well at work.
